arxiv-2102-09105.title: DeepMetaHandles: Learning Deformation Meta-Handles of 3D Meshes with Biharmonic Coordinates
arxiv-2102-09105.creator: Minghua Liu 1 Minhyuk Sung 2 Radomir Mech 3 Hao Su 1 1 University of California San Diego 2 KAIST 3 Adobe Research
arxiv-2102-09105.description: Abstract We propose DeepMetaHandles , a 3D conditional generative model based on mesh deformation. Given a collection of 3D meshes of a category and their deformation handles (control points), our method learns a set of meta-handles for each shape, which are represented as combinations of the given handles.

arxiv-2205-09457.title: Preparation of 87 Rb and 133 Cs in the motional ground state of a single optical tweezer
arxiv-2205-09457.creator: S Spence, R V Brooks, D K Ruttley, A Guttridge, Simon L Cornish
arxiv-2205-09457.description: Abstract We report simultaneous Raman sideband cooling of a single 87 Rb atom and a single 133 Cs atom held in separate optical tweezers at 814 nm and 938 nm, respectively. Starting from outside the Lamb-Dicke regime, after 45 ms of cooling we measure probabilities to occupy the three-dimensional motional ground state of 0.86 − 0.04 + 0.03 {}^{+0.03}_{-0.

arxiv-2304-06799.title: 179 Ta(n, γ \gamma ) cross-section measurement and the astrophysical origin of 180 Ta isotope
arxiv-2304-06799.creator: R. Garg, S. Dellmann, C. Lederer-Woods, C. G. Bruno, K. Eberhardt, C. Geppert, T. Heftrich, I. Kajan, F. Käppeler, B. Phoenix, R. Reifarth, D. Schumann, M. Weigand, C. Wheldon
arxiv-2304-06799.description: Abstract 180m Ta is nature’s rarest (quasi) stable isotope and its astrophysical origin is an open question. A possible production site of this isotope is the slow neutron capture process in Asymptotic Giant Branch stars, where it can be produced via neutron capture reactions on unstable 179 Ta.

arxiv-2405-17571.title: Bluesky: Network Topology, Polarization, and Algorithmic Curation
arxiv-2405-17571.creator: Dorian Quelle, Alexandre Bovet
arxiv-2405-17571.description: Abstract Bluesky is a nascent “Twitter-like” and decentralized social media network with novel features and unprecedented data access. This paper provides a characterization of its interaction network, studying the political leaning, polarization, network structure, and algorithmic curation mechanisms of five million users. The dataset spans from the website’s first release in February of 2023 to May of 2024.

arxiv-2410-08058.title: Closing the Loop: Learning to Generate Writing Feedback via Language Model Simulated Student Revisions
arxiv-2410-08058.creator: Inderjeet Nair, Jiaye Tan, Xiaotian Su, Anne Gere, Xu Wang, Lu Wang
arxiv-2410-08058.description: Abstract Providing feedback is widely recognized as crucial for refining students’ writing skills. Recent advances in language models (LMs) have made it possible to automatically generate feedback that is actionable and well-aligned with human-specified attributes. However, it remains unclear whether the feedback generated by these models is truly effective in enhancing the quality of student revisions.

arxiv-2504-07264.title: Fast algorithms for complex-valued discrete Fourier transform with separate real and imaginary inputs/outputs
arxiv-2504-07264.creator: Aleksandr Cariow
arxiv-2504-07264.description: Abstract Fast Fourier transform algorithms are an arsenal of effective tools for solving various problems of analysis and high-speed processing of signals of various natures. Almost all of these algorithms are designed to process sequences of complex-valued data when each element of the sequence represents a single whole.

arxiv-2512-01061.title: Opening the Sim-to-Real Door for Humanoid Pixel-to-Action Policy Transfer
arxiv-2512-01061.creator: Haoru Xue 1,2∗ , Tairan He 1,3∗ , Zi Wang 1∗ , Qingwei Ben 1,4 , Wenli Xiao 1,3 , Zhengyi Luo 1 , Xingye Da 1 , Fernando Castañeda 1 , Guanya Shi 3 , Shankar Sastry 2 , Linxi “Jim” Fan 1† , Yuke Zhu 1† 1 NVIDIA 2 UC Berkeley 3 CMU 4 CUHK ∗ Equal Contribution † Project Leads
arxiv-2512-01061.description: Abstract Recent progress in GPU-accelerated, photorealistic simulation has opened a scalable data-generation path for robot learning, where massive physics and visual randomization allow policies to generalize beyond curated environments. Building on these advances, we develop a teacher-student-bootstrap learning framework for vision-based humanoid loco-manipulation, using articulated-object interaction as a representative high-difficulty benchmark.

pmc-10574040.title: Epigenetic Biomarkers of Metabolic Responses to Lifestyle Interventions
pmc-10574040.creator: Omar Ramos-Lopez, Barbara Obermayer-Pietsch
pmc-10574040.description: Studies have examined the possible utility of epigenetic phenomena (DNA methylation changes, covalent histone modifications, and miRNA expression patterns) in predicting individual responses to different lifestyle programs. Nonetheless, most available evidence is focused on identifying epigenetic marks eventually associated with body composition and adiposity outcomes, whereas their roles in metabolic endings remain less explored.

pmc-11337781.title: Application of PARP inhibitors combined with immune checkpoint inhibitors in ovarian cancer
pmc-11337781.creator: Fen Xiao, ZhiBin Wang, Liu Qiao, Xiu Zhang, NaYiYuan Wu, Jing Wang, Xing Yu
pmc-11337781.description: The advent of polyadenosine diphosphate ribose polymerase inhibitors (PARPi) has brought about significant changes in the field of ovarian cancer treatment. However, in 2022, Rucaparib, Olaparib, and Niraparib, had their marketing approval revoked for third-line and subsequent therapies due to an increased potential for adverse events. Consequently, the exploration of new treatment modalities remains imperative.

pmc-11511390.title: A Depth Awareness and Learnable Feature Fusion Network for Enhanced Geometric Perception in Semantic Correspondence
pmc-11511390.creator: Fazeng Li, Chunlong Zou, Juntong Yun, Li Huang, Ying Liu, Bo Tao, Yuanmin Xie, Anastasios Doulamis
pmc-11511390.description: Deep learning is becoming the most widely used technology for multi-sensor data fusion. Semantic correspondence has recently emerged as a foundational task, enabling a range of downstream applications, such as style or appearance transfer, robot manipulation, and pose estimation, through its ability to provide robust correspondence in RGB images with semantic information.

pmc-13176113.title: Neuroprotective Properties of Litchi chinensis and Its Phytochemicals in Preclinical Models of Alzheimer's Disease
pmc-13176113.creator: Emon Mia, Md Arif Hossain, Asmaul Husna Bristy, Rakib Hossan, Uzma Asif, Asif Khan Sherwani, Mohammad Y Alshahrani, Samy Selim, Imam Hossen Rakib, Noshin Tasnim Yana, Khadija Akter, Md Sakib Al Hasan
pmc-13176113.description: PurposeAlzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder involving amyloid‐β deposition, tau hyperphosphorylation, oxidative stress, and neuroinflammation. This review systematically evaluates the neuroprotective effects of Litchi chinensis and its phytochemicals against AD, focusing on modulation of Aβ accumulation, tau pathology, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, apoptosis, and synaptic dysfunction using available preclinical evidence.

pmc-13352687.title: A novel interoceptive subfornical organ to infralimbic cortex mechanism relays airway inflammation effects on fear extinction
pmc-13352687.creator: Emily Allgire, Jaclyn W McAlees, Rebecca A Ahlbrand, Elizabeth Mancz, Lauren L Vollmer, Andrew Winter, Katherine MJ McMurray, Laura Maile, Bryan Sanders, William G Ryan, Allan-Hermann Pool, Igal Ifergan, Eric S Wohleb, Steve Davidson, Robert E McCullumsmith, Ian P Lewkowich, Renu Sah
pmc-13352687.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). There is growing interest in the impact of internal body states on the brain and behavior. The detrimental effects of chronic lung inflammation on mental health are well recognized; however, underlying mechanisms are not known. Here, using a murine model of allergic asthma we report compromised fear extinction in mice with severe but not mild airway inflammation (AI); an effect abolished by anti-interleukin-17 A (IL-17 A) antibodies.

pmc-13520763.title: Incidence, Prevalence, and Risk Factors of Dog Bites in Pediatric Populations: Protocol for a Systematic Review
pmc-13520763.creator: Nathaniel LaBarre, Michael Karo, Vidhani Goel, Roberto Sagaribay, Vinnesa Narvaez, Ami Shah, Aditi Singh, Fatehali Peera, Kavita Batra
pmc-13520763.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundDog bites represent a significant global public health concern, particularly among children and adolescents. Approximately 330,000 emergency department visits occur annually in the United States alone due to dog-bite injuries, with pediatric populations bearing a disproportionate burden.
